title: Settings
chatViewModeDeveloperDesc: Full details: thinking process, tool call details, timeline
chatViewModeCleanDesc: Focus on conversation: hide thinking, collapse tool cards, disable timeline
showToolCallsDesc: Display tool invocation blocks in chat
showToolResultsDesc: Display tool execution results in chat
showThinkingDesc: Display AI reasoning process in chat
collapseThinkingDesc: Auto-collapse thinking blocks once streaming completes
collapseToolCardsDesc: Tool cards (Bash, etc.) default to collapsed title bar; click to expand details
showTimelineDesc: Display activity timeline in the message area
showMemoryEntriesDesc: Display memory search, save, and organize processes in chat (for debugging)
retryEnabledDesc: Automatically retry on model API errors (rate limit, timeout, 5xx)
retryMaxRetriesDesc: Maximum number of retry attempts on failure
retryBaseDelayDesc: Initial wait time before the first retry
retryMaxDelayDesc: Upper limit for exponential backoff delay
proxyEnabledDesc: Convert localhost / LAN addresses to public HTTPS URLs (used when previewing images, HTML, etc.)
proxyStatusActive: Proxy is enabled; local preview URLs will be converted automatically
proxyStatusPreferred: Enable preference saved; waiting for server configuration
proxyStatusNotConfigured: Server is missing PROXY_API_URL / PROXY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN, so proxy cannot be enabled
proxyApiUrlDesc: Proxy registration API address (from .env PROXY_API_URL, can be overridden temporarily)
